# SvelteKit\: Prerendered paths are interpreted as regular expressions in Vercel route config generated by @sveltejs/adapter\-vercel and @sveltejs/adapter\-static

- **ID**: CVE\-2026\-128121 / GHSA\-jf9x\-2fg2\-hx4w
- **危険度**: Medium（警告） (CVSS 5.9)
- **言語**: JavaScript/TypeScript
- **パッケージ**: npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-vercel &lt; 6\.3\.5 → 6\.3\.5, npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-static &gt;\= 4\.0\.0\-next\.0, &lt; 4\.0\.1 → 4\.0\.1, npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-vercel &gt;\= 7\.0\.0\-next\.0, &lt; 7\.0\.2 → 7\.0\.2, npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-static &lt; 3\.0\.11 → 3\.0\.11
- **公開**: 2026-11-13

## 原文

If an attacker could influence a link that was crawled during the prerender phase, that link could later be interpreted as a regex in the Vercel routing configuration\.
